interaction_summary: Grace and Rocky interact for the first time after Rocky modifies the tunnel. Grace observes Rocky's magnetic transportation system, learns about his biology, and collaborates with him to develop a plan to combat the Astrophage. They share scientific knowledge, discuss ship technology, and agree to work together on saving Earth and Erid.
trust_level: Growing trust through mutual respect and shared goals
emotional_shift: Initial envy (Rocky sees the alien ship) shifts to curiosity and collaboration
important_quote: "You and me science how to kill Astrophage together. Save Earth. Save Erid. This is good plan, question?"
